issues.description: In solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java the fields are declared in snake_case (lecture_name, number_of_inscribed_students, number_of_guest_students, number_of_lecturers, number_of_tutors), but the constructor, getters/setters, and other methods reference camelCase fields (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, etc.) that are not declared. This makes the provided solution uncompilable and contradicts the problem statement/UML which specifies the camelCase attribute names.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the UML/problem statement by renaming the declared fields to camelCase (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), or alternatively update all method bodies to reference the existing snake_case fields. Ensure only one naming scheme is used throughout the class.
